categories.label: Game-day accuracy nowcast
categories.summary: A separate game-day accuracy layer uses the freshest defensible market consensus and verified context while the canonical Week 6 projection remains immutable for honest prospective grading.

items.title: Why the market anchors today's pure prediction
items.detail: Across 816 walk-forward games, market spread MAE was 9.7445 versus 10.2564 for the canonical model, and market total MAE was 10.1207 versus 10.5001. The accuracy nowcast therefore uses market consensus as the prediction anchor without replacing the independent model.

items.title: Canonical model stays frozen

categories.label: Creator-source overlay
categories.summary: Creator-level outputs from Evan Abrams/Action Network, Dr. David Chao/SICScore and Nick Giffen/Action Luck Rankings are logged as distinct evidence layers rather than blended into an unvalidated expert score.

items.title: Abrams / Action
items.detail: Abrams' Week 6 systems, backup-QB research, key-number and QB-value work are used as context and hypothesis generation. Tyler Huntley's historical backup profile reduces confidence in a generic replacement-QB penalty, but no unvalidated point value is added.

items.title: Chao / SICScore
items.detail: SIC medical-effectiveness and position-group injury context refines reliability around clusters such as the Chargers' OL/secondary and other Week 6 personnel issues. Official NFL/team active-inactive status remains authoritative.

items.title: Giffen / Luck Rankings
items.detail: Giffen's Luck Rankings remain a separate expected-score/regression challenger. Week 6 has two official side signals and no official total signals; LAC +8.5 creates a material conflict with injury context that otherwise leans toward Kansas City.

items.title: LAC-KC conflict flag
items.detail: LAC-KC is explicitly treated as higher side uncertainty: SIC injury-cluster context is unfavorable for Los Angeles, while Giffen's official Luck signal favors the Chargers at +8.5. The model does not resolve that disagreement by inventing a coefficient.

categories.label: Injuries & availability
categories.summary: NFL starter identity, official game status and replacement uncertainty are kept separate from unvalidated point adjustments.

items.title: Hard QB state breaks
items.detail: 3 current matchup(s) are classified as hard starting-QB breaks: CAR-PHI, PIT-TB and BAL-CLE. They remain reliability/release gates; the operational QB point adjustment remains zero unless historically earned.

items.title: Latest personnel refinements
items.detail: New England activated A.J. Brown and he is expected to play, with TreVeyon Henderson trending toward playing; Pittsburgh cleared DK Metcalf while Pat Freiermuth was newly added as questionable with a calf issue. Final inactive lists still supersede all pregame expectations.

items.title: Final inactives
items.detail: Official game-day inactive lists remain a required gate by kickoff window. Primary-source confirmation supersedes questionable tags; when a final list cannot be verified, the model leaves the gate open rather than inferring availability.

items.title: Replacement quality
items.detail: Depth chart, prior NFL performance and personnel context are recorded, but historical injury-burden coefficients were unstable and therefore were not promoted.

categories.label: Weather & venue
categories.summary: Wind, precipitation, temperature and roof state are timestamped context, with elevated uncertainty surfaced rather than converted into arbitrary points.

items.title: Tampa elevated wind
items.detail: The latest NWS point forecast near the 1 PM window is around 77 F with sustained wind near 16 mph and gusts around 23 mph. PIT-TB retains elevated environmental uncertainty without an arbitrary point adjustment.

items.title: Green Bay evening wind
items.detail: The latest NWS point forecast near the Sunday-night kickoff trends toward roughly mid-50s F and about 11 mph sustained wind. DAL-GB is treated as low-to-moderate kickoff wind pending the evening recheck, not as a forced total adjustment.

items.title: Roof decisions remain gates
items.detail: Any unresolved Atlanta or Indianapolis retractable-roof decision stays pending until an authoritative game-day decision is available; the model does not infer open/closed status.

items.title: Historical weather restraint
items.detail: Observed postgame weather is not backfilled as if it were a pregame forecast. Weather remains prospective context until timestamp-safe historical forecast data supports a learned coefficient.

categories.label: Line movement & market
categories.status: Accuracy anchor · not a bet signal
categories.summary: The core NFL projection remains market-independent. The separate accuracy nowcast uses current consensus because historical pure-prediction MAE favors the market, while public prices remain non-executable benchmarks unless verified.

items.title: Latest cross-source audit
items.detail: Same-day Action Network and Covers feeds were rechecked at 2026-10-18T13:42:27Z. Small disagreements are represented as ranges and research midpoints rather than false single-price precision.

items.title: BUF-LV dispersion
items.detail: BUF-LV currently carries the widest non-quarantined checked spread range at roughly BUF -4.5 to -5.5. The displayed research midpoint is not an executable quote.

items.title: NO-NYG conflict quarantine
items.detail: Current NO-NYG sources remain contradictory on spread side direction, including within-source presentation. The spread nowcast is intentionally blank/quarantined until a stable executable consensus is available.

items.title: Execution verification
items.detail: No current game has account-level execution verification. Public-board prices cannot support ROI or CLV claims and do not authorize PLAY/LEAN recommendations.

categories.label: Trends & systems
categories.summary: Trend and system information is displayed only when the record/sample/source requirements are met; it is not allowed to move projections or recommendation strength without prospective evidence.

items.title: Verified trend inventory
items.detail: The current NFL trend payload contains 24 verified entries across 8 games, with explicit sample/record/source fields.

items.title: No trend coefficient
items.detail: ATS/OU streaks, public splits and editorial systems remain descriptive context. They have zero direct projection, confidence or recommendation weight in the canonical model.

items.title: Freshness policy
items.detail: Current weekly systems and market-facing trends may be cross-checked against same-week creator sources, but stale or contradictory claims are excluded rather than backfilled into the model.

categories.label: Efficiency & model architecture
categories.summary: The NFL spread model uses only feature families that survived leakage-safe out-of-sample testing.

items.title: Canonical spread
items.detail: Current spread architecture: frozen core + defensive coverage + market-independent win Elo + margin rating. Historical 2023-25 OOS MAE: 10.2564.

items.title: Canonical total
items.detail: Current total architecture: frozen core only. Historical 2023-25 OOS MAE: 10.5001.

items.title: Win probability
items.detail: Canonical-margin probability mapping passed the predeclared display gate. 2024 walk-forward Brier 0.215097 / log loss 0.620264; 2025 Brier 0.225016 / log loss 0.639583. This authorizes research/display probability only, not moneyline edge or wagering.

items.title: Rejected layers stay rejected
items.detail: NGS tracking, trenches, drive/pace, red-zone, turnover, special-teams, penalties, static travel/roof, historical injury-burden candidates and editorial trends were not promoted when robust validation did not support them.

categories.label: Prospective validation
categories.summary: The model can publish research projections only after prospective evidence accumulates; betting recommendation thresholds require a larger, separate evidence gate.

items.title: Current prospective sample
items.detail: 0 completed prospectively frozen game(s) across 1 frozen week(s). The Week 6 snapshot is immutable and will be graded after games finish.

items.title: Projection beta review
items.detail: Review eligibility begins at 40+ completed prospective games across at least 3 frozen weeks; this is not automatic promotion.

items.title: Recommendation calibration
items.detail: PLAY/LEAN/HOLD calibration review begins only at 75+ completed games across at least 5 weeks, and still requires explicit evidence review.

categories.label: Weekly production workflow
categories.summary: Each NFL week follows the same frozen-snapshot, game-day-gate, grading and registry process before any website release decision.

items.title: Pregame freeze
items.detail: Canonical and challenger projections are timestamped before games and are never rewritten after results are known.

items.title: Game-day gates
items.detail: Final inactives, starter confirmation, creator-source context, roof/weather and fresh public-book benchmarks are refreshed separately from the frozen numerical prediction.

items.title: Postgame grading
items.detail: Canonical, FTN50 shadow and separately logged external challenger signals are graded without rewriting the frozen snapshot, then the multi-week registry updates calibration and model-health diagnostics.
